MDG.note: D-CLIC trains young people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Madagascar's Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training and the OIF launched on 19 January 2026 a new phase of D-CLIC to train 1,000 young people free in digital skills by mid-2026, within a goal of 40,000 by 2028.

systems.owner: OIF with Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training
